name: Ore to 5-nin no Yome-san ga Raburabu nano wa, Mirai kara Kita Aka-chan no Okage ni Chigainai!?
original_name: 俺と５人の嫁さんがラブラブなのは、未来からきた赤ちゃんのおかげに違いない！？
source:
The protagonist was living a relatively normal school life when one day, a baby appeared together with thunder! He didn't believe it, but it was his own daughter from the future. Forced to take care of the baby, a 'baby club' was created at school with his classmates, kouhais and teacher helping him. That's one problem solved, but then he inherited a large enterprise. Due to countermeasures against the declining birthrate, the rich must have multiple wives. So, he proposed to all the members in the baby club.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
主人公原本过着相对正常的校园生活，直到有一天，一个婴儿伴随着雷电出现了！他不敢相信，但那确实是来自未来的他自己的女儿。被迫照顾婴儿后，学校里成立了一个“育婴社”，同学们、后辈们和老师都来帮忙。一个问题解决了，但他又继承了一家大型企业。由于应对出生率下降的措施，富人必须娶多个妻子。于是他向育婴社的所有成员都求了婚。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
